title: ICAB C3 - Business, Technology and Finance
summary: Introduces business operations, organisational design, financial markets, strategic management, corporate governance, CSR, and digital transformation.

all.name: Full Syllabus Tracker
all.blurb: Official 2025 Syllabus chapter and topic tracker for Business, Technology and Finance. Track your study progress across all syllabus areas.

stages.title: Area 1: Business Objectives & Functions
stages.name: Area 1: Business Objectives & Functions
stages.description: Business purpose, mission, stakeholder theory, and core operational functions.

nodes.name: Business Purpose, Stakeholders & Functions
nodes.description: What is a business; primary and secondary objectives; profit-seeking vs non-profit; Mendelow's stakeholder matrix; core business functions: Operations, Marketing, HR, IT, and Finance.
topics: Business definitions, mission statements, vision and values
Stakeholder identification and Mendelow's Power-Interest matrix
Core functional areas: Marketing mix (4Ps/7Ps), Operations management, Supply chain
Human Resource Management: Recruitment, appraisal, and labor regulations
Coordination between business functions to deliver customer value
learningOutcomes: Analyze organizational objectives and stakeholder expectations.
Apply Mendelow's matrix to categorize stakeholder influence.
Describe how core business functions interact.
checklists: Summarize marketing 7Ps and supply chain concepts
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 2: Business & Organisational Structures
stages.name: Area 2: Business & Organisational Structures
stages.description: Organisational design, centralization vs decentralization, Mintzberg's configurations.

nodes.name: Organisational Structures & Design
nodes.description: Management hierarchy, authority, power, delegation, span of control; functional, divisional, matrix and boundaryless structures; Mintzberg's five organisational configurations; shared service centres and outsourcing.
topics: Power, authority, responsibility, and accountability definitions
Tall vs flat organizational structures and span of control
Functional, divisional, matrix, and project-based structures
Mintzberg's 5 organizational building blocks and configurations
Centralization vs decentralization trade-offs
Shared service centers, outsourcing, and offshoring models
learningOutcomes: Evaluate advantages and disadvantages of various organizational structures.
Assess structural fit with strategic objectives.
checklists: Draw matrix and divisional structure comparison diagrams
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 3: The Role of Finance & Financial Markets
stages.name: Area 3: The Role of Finance & Financial Markets
stages.description: Finance function structure, capital markets, banking system, and sources of finance.

nodes.name: Finance Function & Financial Markets
nodes.description: Role of the finance function: Treasury, financial accounting, management accounting; the banking system and Bangladesh Bank; money markets vs capital markets; equity, debt, Islamic finance (Sukuk, Murabaha); SME financing options.
topics: Key responsibilities of the modern finance function
Financial intermediaries, central banking role of Bangladesh Bank
Money markets (Treasury bills, commercial paper) vs Capital markets (Shares, bonds)
Stock exchanges: Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) and Chittagong Stock Exchange (CSE)
Short-term vs long-term sources of business finance
Islamic finance principles and key contracts: Murabaha, Ijara, Mudaraba, Sukuk
Microfinance, angel investing, and venture capital for SMEs in Bangladesh
learningOutcomes: Explain the structure and responsibilities of the finance function.
Differentiate money market and capital market instruments in Bangladesh.
Compare conventional finance with Islamic financial contracts.
checklists: Study DSE and capital market structure
Compare equity vs debt financing pros and cons
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 4: External Environment of Business
stages.name: Area 4: External Environment of Business
stages.description: PESTEL environmental analysis, Porter's Five Forces, macroeconomic policy.

nodes.name: PESTEL Analysis & Industry Competitiveness
nodes.description: PESTEL framework (Political, Economic, Social, Technological, Environmental, Legal); macroeconomic policies (fiscal, monetary, inflation, interest rates, exchange rates); Porter's Five Forces industry analysis.
topics: Macro-environmental scanning using PESTEL
Fiscal policy, government expenditure, taxation, and budget deficits
Monetary policy, interest rate transmission, and foreign exchange reserves
Demographic trends and socio-cultural shifts in emerging markets
Porter's Five Forces: Buyer power, supplier power, substitutes, new entrants, rivalry
Competitor analysis and industry life cycle phases
learningOutcomes: Conduct a PESTEL analysis for a commercial enterprise.
Explain how fiscal and monetary policy decisions affect businesses.
Apply Porter's Five Forces to evaluate industry attractiveness.
checklists: Practice PESTEL breakdown on a Bangladesh textile or fintech firm
Map Porter's 5 forces for local pharmaceutical industry
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 5: Governance, Ethics & CSR
stages.name: Area 5: Governance, Ethics & CSR
stages.description: Corporate governance codes, agency theory, board structures, ethical culture, and CSR.

nodes.name: Corporate Governance & Sustainability
nodes.description: Agency theory and conflict of interest; role of the Board of Directors, NEDs, and Audit Committee; BSEC Corporate Governance Code; corporate social responsibility (CSR); sustainability reporting frameworks.
topics: Separation of ownership and control (Agency problem)
Corporate governance principles: Fairness, Transparency, Accountability, Responsibility
Board composition: Executive vs Independent Non-Executive Directors (NEDs)
Role of board committees: Audit, Nomination, Remuneration
BSEC Corporate Governance Code requirements for listed companies in Bangladesh
Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) and stakeholder engagement
Triple Bottom Line (People, Planet, Profit) and UN SDGs
learningOutcomes: Explain the agency theory and governance mechanisms to protect shareholders.
State the requirements of BSEC Corporate Governance Code.
Describe how CSR and sustainability impact long-term corporate value.
checklists: Review key provisions of BSEC Corporate Governance Code 2018
Summarize duties and independence requirements of Audit Committee
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)

stages.title: Area 6: Technology, Data Analysis & Digitalization
stages.name: Area 6: Technology, Data Analysis & Digitalization
stages.description: Cloud computing, Big Data, AI, automation, cybersecurity, and digital business models.

nodes.name: Digital Transformation & Data Analytics
nodes.description: Digital disruption and business model innovation (e-commerce, platforms, FinTech); Big Data characteristics (5Vs); Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Robotic Process Automation (RPA) in business; cloud services (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS); cybersecurity threats and data protection fundamentals.
topics: Digital business models: E-commerce, platform ecosystems, subscription economy
Big Data analytics: Volume, Velocity, Variety, Veracity, Value
AI and Machine Learning applications in accounting, auditing, and forecasting
Robotic Process Automation (RPA) for routine finance operations
Cloud computing architectures and benefits/risks for enterprise systems
Cybersecurity threats: Phishing, ransomware, data breaches, and controls
Data privacy, Bangladesh Cyber Security Act, and ethical use of customer data
learningOutcomes: Explain how emerging technologies transform business models and finance operations.
Identify the business value and risks of Big Data and Artificial Intelligence.
Recognize cybersecurity threats and essential enterprise control measures.
checklists: Learn the 5Vs of Big Data and their business applications
Understand Cloud deployment models (Public, Private, Hybrid)
Review Cyber Security Act data protection obligations
resources: Relevant Acts & Standards (IFRS / ISA / Tax Acts)
